summary: The GCP Big Data Engineer builds, manages, and optimizes scalable big data pipelines and platforms using Google Cloud services.
responsibilities: Implement data pipelines using BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub
Develop batch and streaming ETL/ELT workflows
Optimize cloud data storage, compute, and query performance
Ensure data security, governance, and compliance
Collaborate with data science and analytics teams

education: 3–6 years of GCP big data experience

skills_required.name: Expertise in GCP services (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage)
Strong SQL, Python, and Java/Scala programming
Knowledge of distributed computing and cloud architecture
Experience with monitoring and logging tools
